notes.title: Patch Released: Soros Has Arrived!
notes.content:

Mouse Wheel now changes equipped slot.

4 New Potions
New Potion Vendor for Medals in Secret Passage

=======
Boss Battle is now far easier. Enemy damage reduced 40%.
King Tut Speed reduced.
Running sideways no longer doubles your speed.
Corn harvest greatly increased.

Numerous bug fixes throughout the game.

Keep the ideas coming! Up next is most likely a PvP patch.

notes.title: Hardmode Weapons and Armor Patch Notes
notes.content:
In order to thank members of this community who have helped me test throughout the development process, I've named several of the hardmode weapons after them. The next stage of the game, the boss gauntlet, will include additional people's names in the gun titles. So if you aren't in one yet then just friend me and play Blocked and Loaded!

There are 3 new pieces of armor and 5 weapons; all purchaseable from vendors in the Secret Passage.

While you wait for the gauntlet to come out, you will want to take the time to run hard mode until you are content with your loadout.

Hard Mode runs get expensive if you die playing solo, so be sure to team up!

Other Tweaks:
============
Complete hard mode without dying for +4 Medals
Alt tab no longer holds mouse in center screen
Chest spawn rates drop by 50%. Inside chests increased by 20%.
Rocket Launcher was doing double damage, fixed
Several guns needed rebalancing on speed, damage and/or accuracy
The accuracy stat was nerfed by 25%
Big Bat has started working out and can fly 10x as fast
Escort quest now says "Medal Awarded" when in hard mode
Item duplicaion bug fixed
'X' screen bug removed that deleted nearby items
Clear ring now only removes non-hard mode debuffs
Trading is restricted by character level
I believe I fixed the Big Bat respawn bug when host leaves

What's Coming
============
Boss Gauntlet
Professions
PvP Team Games

THEN RELEASE OF THE GAME. THIS IS THE HOME STRETCH!

notes.title: Please Read: Additional Updates to World 3 Patch
notes.content:
Your ideas have greatly influenced the flow the game. Prepare for a much harder, harsher world adventurer!

=======What's New======
World 3 loot, quests, levels, bosses, and enemies are introduced with this patch.
New Outpost defense level in World 3.
New PvP zone for World 3.
Lifesteal buff added.
Press X to see your stat screen.
/cry emote.
Vendors and Traders now show names of wares next to price.
Quests now show '!' when available and '?' when complete on radar.


=======Tweaks=========
Golems (desert world shooting enemies) now have 50% better accuracy.
Players have 50% wider hit boxes for npc bullets.
Chests cost significantly more.
9999 gold cap raised from 999.
Reduced damage on fireball talisman.


========Bug Fixes=======
Visiting homes no longer results in you getting stuck indefinitely while waiting for a home to load.
Cities can now properly support 32 people. A bug kept them at 4 previously.
Soros Construct now fires shots randomly in stage 2 instead of in a line.
Enemy spawns doubled in outpost level. Bring a friend for sure!
Bullets now despawn between levels.
Chest in icy river no longer spawning in an unreachable location.
Resurrect no longer causes you to spawn in the floor.
Ice World PvP area no longer spawns you in a tree sometimes.
Visiting home should no longer sometimes result in getting stuck outside of the home.


=======Coming Up Next===
Professions - namely cooking, blacksmithing and alchemy.
More mini-games for cities and at home.
Fireworks... why not right?
Item trading system while in Hope City.
Player list when people are in the same area.


Thank you all I had so much fun playing with you! Keep the ideas coming!

Warning: Your game will likely crash if you don't get the latest update due to players joining you with new skins/weapons/emotes/etc.

5 Maps to Explore and Quest in.
2 Bosses (1 Mini-boss with good loot and 1 Big-Boss with great loot).
Dying as a group now causes everyone to go home.
Dying in the further desert areas only sets you back to the Desert City.
Emote with /wave, /point, /yes, and /no.
New PvP Zone is available to those players who can reach the Desert City.
Many new weapons, armors and new gadgets known as bracelets.

Keep the feedback coming and especially any ideas you have for mini-games let me know!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OtKCOygAHO4

notes.title: Latest Patch - Death By Save File Fixed
notes.content:
A good number of people were not able to start up the game correctly (showed you as dead immediately) due to a save file permissions bug on some windows machines.

I have changed the save file location to %APPDATA% which will appear in the steam application folder that the game launches from.

If you already have a save file at the old location: C:\BlockedAndLoaded
You can copy the Save_File.xml located there into the %APPDATA% folder where steam installed Blocked and Loaded. Once there, rename the Save_File.xml to BandL_Save_File.xml and you will retain your old save.

My apologies for this complicated process, this issue did not come up during Steam testing, my own testing on four different pcs, etc. If you really like your character then do the process above to restore it.

If you wre having the issue, let me know if it is resolved now!

Thank you and world 2 is well under way,

Chris
